title: W13 VC-2/VC-7: host-owned HX, RF-preview and detached observation projection wiring
description:
Gap (groomed by flywheel seat g1 round 2, run g2-work-r3; measured at rig origin/workbench/implementation-program 4fc7a9d): wb-0kg.5 landed the pure local-detached reader adapter (src/workbench/detached-observer.ts, projectDetachedReading({ receipt, snapshot, scope, operator, observedAt }) -> NativeSnapshots plus a native-confirmed ownership edge) at trunk base a8152e6, but nothing applies it: per the wb-0kg.5 measurement, git grep local-detached -- src outside hosts/local-detached.ts hits only the src/index.ts import, and the workflow_detached tool returns the raw snapshot JSON without ingest or relate, so a detached invocation never appears in the four-view inspector or workflow_observe (both read the projection only). Same unwired-reader class the owner approved for held-pattern filing (BOUNDARY 14:33Z GROOM PATTERN); the local-detached surface gate was pre-bound at 14:53Z.

Scope: the host seam that launches or attaches the local detached profile applies the landed projectDetachedReading to the live ObservationProjection via refresh+relate with host-bound scope, operator and injected clock; the workflow_detached reply reads the refreshed projection, never the raw snapshot; live-detached-host observations project current, local-client-transport and unknown project stale/unknown and are never upgraded; no replayed terminal verdict; no new grant minted; the wiring sends no command.

Owner-routed wiring-bead lines from the wb-0kg.5 gate dispositions ("Minor items (equal-instant refresh guard, multi-byte '[truncated]' marker loss, pid-cap parity with 0kg.6) -> lines for the wiring bead and the deferred bundle"): (1) equal-instant refresh guard: a second reading at an equal observedAt instant never regresses status; (2) the byte clamp never eats the '[truncated]' marker on multi-byte content; (3) pid-cap parity with wb-0kg.6.

Excluded: src/workbench/detached-observer.ts and src/workbench/hosts/local-detached.ts untouched; control plane untouched (wb-cra owner-reserved); census untouched (workflow_detached is already registered, no new tool).

Quote basis: docs/workbench in the rig (branch workbench/implementation-program), measured at 4fc7a9d. All red-first.
B1 docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md section "Reader adapters": "Reader adapter returns snapshot {nativeRef, capturedAt, observedAt, sourceRevision?, coverage?, nativePayloadRef} and optional change stream with cursor." -> the seam feeds the landed projectDetachedReading output into the live ObservationProjection via refresh+relate with host-bound scope, operator and injected clock; nothing invented, no command sent.
B2 docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md section "Relationships are typed and provenanced": "lifecycle ownership (only if native producer confirms)" and "Store edge provenance with timestamp and source" -> the invocation-owns-host-process edge lands only with the receipt-backed nativeConfirmationRef and its provenance (timestamp and source) survives into the projection; ownership is identity, not liveness (BOUNDARY 14:53Z F8): host loss never withdraws the edge while freshness reports stale/unknown.
B3 docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md section "Freshness and ambiguity": "A disconnected Furnace event stream must not make a previously RUNNING node permanently authoritative RUNNING; it becomes last-known-running + stale. Pi tool summaries must communicate that nuance." -> live-detached-host -> current; local-client-transport and unknown -> stale/unknown, never upgraded, no replayed terminal verdict; equal-instant refresh guard: a second reading at an equal observedAt instant never regresses status (wb-0kg.5 gate minor item, owner-routed to this wiring bead).
B4 docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md section "Acceptance/negative controls" item 8: "Closing observer causes zero cancellation calls." -> closing the observing surface issues zero socket traffic and zero control verbs.
B5 docs/workbench/09-observation-and-provenance.md section "Acceptance/negative controls" item 10: "Large/secret payload does not leak into Pi tool result or screen by default." -> REQUIRED red-first case (BOUNDARY 14:33Z): a line-split credential ("Authorization: Bearer" + value on the next line) through the full wired reply comes out redacted; the '[truncated]' marker is never lost to the byte clamp on multi-byte content and the pid cap matches wb-0kg.6 (both owner-routed wb-0kg.5 gate minor items); every reply routes through the shared sanitizers in src/workbench/redaction.ts.
B6 SURFACE GATE: blocked-by wb-952 stands until wb-952 lands (BOUNDARY 14:53Z: wb-952 EIGHTEENTH site = detached-observer.ts shown(); any wiring exposing the local-detached reader's projection to a rendered surface or a model reply is blocked-by wb-952); this bead never widens, duplicates or waits on anything else from the wb-952 helper fix.

dependencies.title: safeWorkflowTerminalText redacts before stripping terminal sequences, so split credentials survive; UNSAFE_TEXT lacks zero-width characters
dependencies.description: Machine gate-seat probe during wb-g1g.1 verification: safeWorkflowTerminalText (src/ui/workflow-card.ts ~149-151) applies redactWorkbenchText BEFORE stripUnsafeText, so a credential interrupted by terminal escape sequences or zero-width characters is not recognized by the redaction pass, and the subsequent strip then reassembles the secret: 4 of 6 probe credentials leaked through the single-pass path. The store's two-pass pipeline (redact after strip) caught all 6 — that order is the fix precedent. Also: the UNSAFE_TEXT class in src/workbench/redaction.ts carries no zero-width range (U+200B-200D, U+FEFF, U+2060), so zero-width-joined secrets survive both passes. Fix: strip first then redact (or redact(strip(v)) composed in one exported helper used by every display path), add the zero-width range to UNSAFE_TEXT, and pin with a drift test that runs the 6-credential probe corpus through every exported sanitizer. Protect the positive: the store pipeline's order already works — do not regress it while unifying.
